_instructions: Capital loans / merchant funding. DELIBERATELY EMPTY of amounts, rates, terms and repayment mechanics. Lending is regulated and every figure carries disclosure requirements — none of it can be written by anyone but you and your compliance people. The page renders a lead form and the qualifying questions only.
heading: Capital When the Business Needs It
lede: Funding for merchants who process with us. Tell us what you need it for and we'll come back with what's available.

faqs.q: Can I get a business loan through my payment processor?
faqs.a: Funding is available to merchants who process with EPAY POS. Tell us what you need it for and we come back with what is available.

faqs.q: What can merchant funding be used for?
faqs.a: Common uses are a new location — fit-out, deposit and equipment for a second site — kitchen equipment and repairs, buying inventory deeper ahead of a season, and bridging payroll or a slow stretch without putting it on a card.

faqs.q: Do I have to process with EPAY to qualify?
faqs.a: Yes. This funding is for merchants already processing with us.
